description: Genre / style modifier dictionary. Verbatim from EricRollei/Local_LLM_Prompt_Enhancer/text_to_image_node.py (genre_guidance map).

genres.cinematic: film-like quality, dramatic lighting, professional composition
genres.dramatic: high contrast, emotional intensity, dynamic tension
genres.indie: artistic, unconventional, creative freedom, unique perspective
genres.horror: dark atmosphere, ominous mood, eerie elements, tension
genres.romantic: soft, intimate, emotional warmth, tender mood
genres.x-rated: mature themes, adult content, sensual elements
genres.pg: family-friendly, clean, wholesome, appropriate for all ages
genres.minimalist: simple, clean, essential elements only, negative space
genres.vintage: classic, retro, aged aesthetic, nostalgic feel
genres.noir: dark, moody, high contrast shadows, mystery
genres.cyberpunk: neon, futuristic dystopia, tech, gritty urban
genres.steampunk: retro-futuristic contraptions, brass machinery, victorian flair
genres.dieselpunk: industrial grit, roaring engines, interwar aesthetics
genres.mythic: legendary scale, archetypal symbolism, timeless myth
genres.gothic: dramatic architecture, chiaroscuro mood, romantic darkness
genres.art deco: sleek geometry, metallic sheen, roaring twenties glamour
genres.retro futurism: optimistic vintage sci-fi, bold colors, nostalgic futurism
